# CampingRoute.app - AI & LLM Manifest

> CampingRoute is a modern European camping route planner, campsite discovery engine, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

## Overview
- Website: https://campingroute.app
- Discover & Search: https://campingroute.app/discover
- Prompt Generator: https://campingroute.app/prompt-generator
- Supported Languages: German (de), English (en), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl)
- MCP Endpoint: https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp

## Features
- **AI Camping Search**: Natural-language search across 17,000+ campsites, RV pitches, glamping sites, and attractions across 14 European countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Italy, France, Spain, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Netherlands, Belgium, Croatia, Portugal, Luxembourg).
- **Route Planning**: Camper-optimized routing, stages, GPX export, vehicle dimensions, toll avoidance.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Streamable HTTP and SSE tools for AI agents and coding assistants.

## MCP Tools
1. `search_places`: Search campsites, motorhome pitches, glamping, or attractions with filters (country, type, query).
2. `get_place_details`: Retrieve detailed place information, coordinates, amenities, address, and metadata.
3. `get_reviews`: Fetch community reviews and ratings.
4. `add_review`: Submit new traveler reviews.
5. `get_lists`: Fetch user roadtrip collections.
6. `create_list`: Create a new roadtrip list.
7. `save_to_list`: Save places to roadtrip lists.

## Full Documentation
For complete technical schemas and integration guides, see: https://campingroute.app/llms-full.txt
